# OAuth Pathfinder

> Readiness guides for provider OAuth apps: how hard, how long, what gates approval, and what an AI agent can do for you versus what a human must do. A curated, human-verified library plus an agent pipeline that investigates any app you name and streams a shareable guide.

Live site: https://oauth-pathfinder-blue.vercel.app
Source: https://github.com/bhuvan0808/oauth-pathfinder
Submitted for the Composio APM Integrations take-home.

## Mental model

- Two clocks per guide. Dev-ready: time until the developer can get a token for themselves. Production: time until any user can connect without caps, warnings or admin consent, including approval waits.
- Owners on every step: agent (research, drafting, scope choice, pre-filled values) or you (login, terms, payment, business verification, recording a video, clicking submit).
- Evidence on every claim: tested (actually attempted), documented (official page, linked), reported (community or vendor post), inferred (best reading; verify).
- Difficulty 1 to 5: 1 trivial (create app, done), 2 easy, 3 moderate (a distribution or review step), 4 hard (verification with real waiting), 5 gated (paid tier, security assessment, business verification or partner program).

## Deployment mode

This deployment runs in demo mode (MOCK_AGENT=1): live generation uses hand-written fixtures for Linear, Notion, HubSpot, Cal.com, Mercury, Resend, Zoom, Discord, Dropbox, Salesforce and Stripe, and a deliberately low-confidence generic guide for any other app. The probe stage still makes real HTTP requests. Every generated guide is labelled "Demo mode". With ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set and MOCK_AGENT removed, the same pipeline performs live web search and fetch for any app. Check /api/health for the current mode.

## Endpoints

- GET /api/health: mode, configuration flags (no secrets), curated slugs, demo fixture apps, endpoint list.
- GET /api/guides: index of every guide available (curated + cached live) with summary fields and links.
- GET /api/guides/{slug}: full guide JSON ({ tier, guide }).
- GET /api/guides/{slug}?format=md: the guide as Markdown for pasting into Slack, Notion or an agent's context.
- POST /api/generate with JSON body {"query": "<app name or URL>", "force": false}: Server-Sent Events. Event types: stage, activity (kind: search | fetch | probe | note), result, done (includes the full guide and stats), error. If the guide is already available the response is JSON {"cached": true, "slug": "...", "tier": "library" | "live"} instead of a stream. Rate limited per IP per hour.
- Pages: / (library and submit box), /guide/{slug}, /generate?q=<query>[&force=1].

## Curated guides (human-verified)

- /guide/github (difficulty 1)
- /guide/atlassian-jira (3)
- /guide/slack (3)
- /guide/microsoft-entra (4)
- /guide/google-gmail (5)
- /guide/x-twitter (5)

## Documentation in the repository

- README.md: overview, quick start, environment variables, how a guide is generated, what was tested, key decisions, limitations.
- SUBMISSION.md: evaluator note: links, what to click, what is demo vs real.
- VERIFICATION.md: claims checked against official sources, corrections, what could not be verified, manual setup attempts, what backs the demo fixtures, source URL maintenance.
- AGENTS.md: map of the repository for AI agents and new contributors.
- docs/EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md: the problem, the approach, what is proven, risks, roadmap (manager view).
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: request flow, pipeline stages, event schema, storage tiers, evidence rules, file map.
- docs/API.md: every endpoint with request and response examples.
- docs/GUIDE_SCHEMA.md and docs/guide.schema.json: the guide data model and integrity rules.
- docs/DEPLOYMENT.md: local setup, Vercel deployment, switching to live research, Upstash, cost.
- docs/TESTING.md: what was tested, how to re-run it, the live-model checklist.
- docs/DECISIONS.md: design decisions with rationale.
- docs/FAQ.md: common questions, including what changes once an API key is added.
- docs/ROADMAP.md: next increments.
- CHANGELOG.md: what changed when.
- CLAUDE.md: instructions for coding agents working in this repo.

## Source layout

- app/: Next.js App Router pages and API routes.
- components/: GuideView, TwoClocks, Badges, ProgressLog, SubmitBox, LibraryGrid, CopyButton.
- lib/schema.ts: zod schema and integrity checks (parseGuide).
- lib/agent/: pipeline.ts (stages and events), prompts.ts, probe.ts (real HTTP checks), client.ts (Anthropic calls), json.ts, mock.ts and mockFixturesExtra.ts (demo fixtures).
- lib/store.ts: curated loader and live cache (Upstash or memory).
- lib/markdown.ts: Markdown export.
- data/guides/*.json: curated guides.
- scripts/: generate (CLI), validate, linkcheck.
